text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Step, step, step...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As the "Supreme King," I have walked this 
mountain path all along. Aiming for the 
peak, without flinching in the 
slightest...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—An uncharted mountain range. The name of 
the peak I challenged was...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the year-end dream match, the 
Arima Kinen! The excitement today is 
unlike anything in years past!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A clash of old and new, the dream 
showdown! First up among today's leading 
contenders is——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The biggest, the strongest, the absolute 
peak! No one can reach El's heights, 
deeeeesu!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa. The monstrous bird that 
soars higher than the Andes mountains. 
And...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She is also a benefactor who showed me how 
a champion fights during this year's 
summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And the second person is...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Graceful as Fuji... Reaching for the 
pinnacle of the art I seek.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder. An American-born giant of 
Japanese grace. Her lack of arrogance 
stems from pure confidence in her talent.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The twin titans of the previous generation 
have arrived. They couldn't be a more 
perfect wall to overcome.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, the world's highest peak is 
8,848 meters. Then today—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall surpass even that. 8,848 meters... 
plus 3 millimeters!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Most would think it's merely 3 
millimeters. However...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Those three millimeters exceeded once 
will remain immutable for all eternity. 
Even if hundreds of millions of years 
pass!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That is—the power of the "End-of-Century 
Overlord"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLAP!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, one of this year's strongest 
contenders, TM Opera O, makes her grand 
entrance—!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! This... intimidating presence 
is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Emperador... It means "Great King"... yes?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
I am no longer the king of comedy to be 
mocked!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Having acquired the aura and strength to 
make even celebrated Umamusume flinch, she 
makes her grand descent upon the stage of 
the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun, shall we begin? The 
promised finale, determined from the very 
moment we met.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You know what kind of scene the finale is, 
don't you?
choice_data_list:
The "Overlord of the End of the 
Century"—Crowned!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely. And in that very moment, 
the era will shift.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It marks the birth of the T.M. Opera O 
Dynasty, centered around the 
"End-of-Century Overlord."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Opera O...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, Ayabe-san. Keep your eyes on me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Slamming the butt of our scepter into the 
fertile plains of Nakayama, carving the 
mark of our generation for all to see.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Today, I am no longer a challenger.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am the one who will embrace the final 
struggles of the past era and bring it to 
an end! Come at me, heroes of the past 
whom I love and revere!
